data.content_ref: inline:Make reinstatement structural instead of emergent: precompute defense chains up to bounded depth d and use them to seed initial labels, under the constraint that the seeding is monotone (never flips IN to OUT later). Conjecture: for d above the longest defense chain in the polynomial-sized graph, the seeded grounded extension coincides with the standard one, so this is a conservative strengthening that buys explicability (you can point at the chain) without touching determinism or root validity.
